description: A shekarar 2026, tsarin gine-ginen cloud ya zauna kan ginshikai shida: kayan aikin AI-native, multi-cloud mai hikima, zane na serverless-first tare da WebAssembly a gefe, edge computing, tsaro na atomatik tare da crypto-agility, da ayyukan masu kara karfin yawa mai dorewa. Ga banki, tambaya ita ce ko za su ci cloud ko su tsara shi — a karkashin matsin haduwa daga kasuwanci na agentic, tattalin arzikin sashe na agentic, hadarin quantum na harvest-now-decrypt-later, tsaron MCP da yaduwar algorithmic, mahimmancin agent ta cryptography, bukatun continuous-treasury, da EU AI Act.
